about: probe:p365’s grader fixtures (build/p365/probe-p365.mjs --grader-self-test): one honest reading per grader; every clause broken alone and every need left unmet alone; variants a grader must not mistake; raw fixtures in raw/ driven through the one reader and laid over their grader’s honest reading; the one reader’s own numbers over the recorded raw against SPEC §2’s tables; and host sources whose lines must be read and classified. raw/<run>/bundle.json says what in each folder is recorded (the spec step’s runs, their stdout and their dump readings, no dump) and what is constructed. Written by the probe builder from the spec step’s recorded runs and the probe’s own grader names. The probe review added the entries marked "by": "the probe review" and the raw/rv-* runs (constructed, each bundle says so): a hang read as a clean exit, a run cut short, a storm slower than its rate, a storm that never reached the native module, torn lines that hid a crash, an unread reports folder, and parents that are no baseline. Phase 366’s probe review (Electron 43.3.0 to 43.8.7) added the entries marked "by": "Phase 366’s probe review" and the raw/rv366-* runs (constructed, each bundle says so): a storm, quit or kill whose Crashpad never ran or was refused reads UNREADABLE, never "no dump", and a dump of a helper that is neither main nor a watcher process holding watcher.node fails every HEAD storm, quit and kill grader.
